_comment: The register of source documents behind every regulatory fact in this repository. The documents themselves live in a store OUTSIDE the repository — /data/regulations on an installation, override with EMCARGO_REGULATIONS_DIR — because regulatory texts are not ours to redistribute and docs/data-sources.md promises they never enter the repository. What is recorded here is metadata: where a document comes from, which edition it is, and the sha256 of the exact file the facts were read from, so a future reading can prove it read the same book. Managed with scripts/regulations_store.py; architecture and update procedure in docs/regulatory-database.md.

store.note: The fallback is the cache path the CI workflows already persist with actions/cache. A document is looked up by its filename below, identical in every location.

documents.note: Free of charge from the publisher. The server refuses non-browser requests; the store tool knows the way round (browser headers, then the web archive).

documents.title: ADN 2025, official Dutch edition, HTML export indexed by section
documents.publisher: Ministerie van Defensie (visitorsweb.mindef.nl publication of ADN 2025)
documents.role: First reading of adn_table_a.json and of the ADN provisions implemented since v1.71.0. It was the Dutch reading of table C as well until v1.80.0, when the printed edition (adn_nl_2025) took that over: this export splits a row per alternative name, swaps the cells of columns (7) and (9) against its own header and omits UN 1977 and UN 1999. Each was measured and undone; none of it decides a cell any more.
documents.obtained: built from the mindef.nl HTML pages, one JSON object per section number
documents.note: The source host answers only from some networks. The known damage in this edition is recorded where it was found: the 7.1.4.3.4 compatibility matrix (row N carries thirteen cells) and the 7.1.5.0.2 comparison operators.

documents.title: IMDG Code Amendment 42-24 (IMO resolution MSC.556(108))
documents.publisher: IMO, adopted 23 May 2024, in force 1 January 2026
documents.role: First reading of imdg_dgl.json, imdg_codes.json and imdg_42_24.json via scripts/extract_imdg_dgl.py and extract_imdg_codes.py.
documents.obtained: download
documents.note: The IMDG Code itself is paywalled; this amendment resolution is publicly hosted and replaces the complete text of the code, so it carries the full Dangerous Goods List. The operator later supplied the same file (byte-identical) through the shared Drive folder, which confirmed the pin. Verified on 2026-08-26 to carry the complete typeset 2024 edition, not the amendment instructions alone: Parts 1-7, chapters 3.1-3.5 (chapter 3.4 at PDF page 797), Appendix A (generic and N.O.S. proper shipping names, PDF 805), Appendix B (PDF 821) and the index. The operator supplied the same byte-identical file once more through the session upload of 2026-08-26.

documents.title: IMDG Code Supplement, 2020 edition
documents.role: Registered for future reading (EmS Guide, MFAG, reporting procedures). No value in the repository is read from it yet; the EmS entries currently come from MSC.1/Circ.1588/Rev.3 and the 42-24 difference layer.
documents.obtained: operator upload (session zip, 2026-08-26)
documents.note: Honest about what this file is: a text-preserving reconstruction of the 2020 Supplement (678 pages) built from an HTML source, in which 138 of the 184 source images could not be recovered. Its text is searchable and usable; anything figure-based must not be read from it. The 2020 edition pairs with Amendment 40-20 — the EmS Guide as amended by MSC.1/Circ.1588/Rev.3 is newer and stays the EmS source of record.

documents.title: IMDG Code 2024 Edition (Amendment 42-24) — Errata and corrigenda, December 2025
documents.role: Checked in full against the extracted sea seeds (imdg_dgl.json, imdg_codes.json, imdg_42_24.json). Of its eleven corrections, none touches a value the extraction carries: they correct prose, cross-references, an alphabetical order in IBC520, an entry name in T50 and three special-provision texts, all outside the columns that were read.
documents.obtained: operator-supplied via the shared Drive folder (incoming/Imdg)
documents.note: Three pages. The full text was read aloud in the fetch-regulations dump step; the delivery watermark on each page belongs to the download service, not to the content.
